cohort: A single preterm male neonate diagnosed with Posterior urethral valve (PUV) who presented with nonimmune fetal hydrops and intestinal obstruction.
finding: The formation of urinary ascites in Posterior urethral valve (PUV) can serve as a pop-off mechanism to relieve intravesical and intrarenal pressure, potentially leading to transient intestinal obstruction and hepatic synthetic defects when not caused by bladder rupture.
